in Helmsley's portfolio.

healthcare longevity and everything associated with it is one of our themes. So we're

in this little tiny group of five people that was looking for acquisitions in the medical

to get FDA approval. I learned all of those things because I was in such a small, it grew

at the Wolverine Venture Fund. I was still doing consulting. And then we were trying to raise

primarily the entry point at the low level. And when we've tried to bring in people that
